title: Storage Services
description: Learn S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, and AWS Backup. Understand storage classes, lifecycle policies, encryption, and redundancy.
longDescription: Data needs to live somewhere. This module covers every major AWS storage option. You will learn how to store objects in S3 with the right storage class, attach block storage to EC2 with EBS, share files across instances with EFS, run Windows or Lustre workloads with FSx, and protect everything with AWS Backup and Glacier.
whatYouLearn: Choose the right S3 storage class
Use EBS, EFS, and FSx for different workloads
